name: haxe-session-waiter
description: External session-waiter for the Haxe managed-agent lane (ADR-066). Decouples an Anthropic Managed-Agents session's wall-clock from any single n8n execution: holds the long-running session, services client-side tools, and calls n8n back by webhook when the agent delivers. Block 4 = skeleton (health, structured logging, env, handoff persistence, reliability seam); the event loop + tool servicing land in Block 6.
